jobs.occupation: Cyber Services Program and Product Lead (Leiter/in - Projekt-/Programmmanagement)
jobs.description:
As a Cyber Services Product and Program Lead (m/f/d), you will be responsible for shaping Vestas Cyber Security Services.

You will work in Vestas Service business area and manage the commercial portfolio of OT and Cyber Security Services, this is a dual role that combines product and program ownership.

This position sits within Global Service Commercial, under Plant and Energy Solutions Product Development. The responsibility of the department is to define and mature-to-market plant, cyber and digital service offerings for selling long term service agreements and other contractual service offerings within the renewable energy sector. Cyber security is an important strategic initiative that supports Vestas' vision to be a leader in renewable energy solutions and shall ensure long-term profitability and competitiveness of Vestas Service business.

Join us in ensuring resilient cybersecurity solutions in the global renewable energy projects.

Ready to safeguard the energy revolution?

Responsibilities:

As Cyber Services Product and Program Lead you will work closely with global and regional cross-functional teams to lead the roadmap of cyber security services within Vestas' service business. The role will be the Global Service Commercial product lead for bringing ideas to market around Vestas' cyber security offerings.

- Program Management - you oversee the portfolio of our projects in the OT and Cyber Security services area. You are first point of contact on reporting around our initiatives, summarizing development budgets and defining governance in cooperation with other departments. You support strategic work and can manage projects, when needed.
- Service product roadmap - you will be responsible to build a long-term roadmap while ensuring the strategic direction is firm and accepted in close alignment with relevant parts of the business. You will position the services with reference to different market and customer groups, lead competitor and industry analysis, ensure business case development and alignment with relevant functions and integrate commercial and technical elements into cohesive offerings.
- Product Management - you take Cyber Security service product and solutions to market that are scalable, standardized and matured to ensure high market efficiency, risk management optimization and highest possible value contribution. You lead the launch of our solutions and understand what our frontline requires for selling. You can produce relevant commercial documentation, define commercial structures and manage internal product training.
- Requirement management - you understand customer expectations and are skilled in working with Global Experts in gathering requirements, that you will translate towards new services design. On top, you can formulate commercial targets making sure our services can be effectively deployed with customers.You can facilitate alignment across functions when trade-offs are required to deliver effective and scalable solutions.
- Product Accountability - you provide support to the regional sales teams in responding to customer and sales request as a go-to-market lead post-launch.

Qualifications:

- Academic background in Business Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology (IT), Operational Technology (OT), Engineering, or a related field.
- Proven experience as a Project Manager within a technology-driven environment.
- Experience working effectively in a matrix organization.
- Ideally, a background in a commercially focused role
- Solid understanding of networking technologies, SCADA systems, and cybersecurity, gained through professional experience is a plus.
- Previous experience in the renewable energy industry is considered a strong advantage.
- Excellent command of English; German language skills are a plus.

Competencies:

- Genuine passion for the renewable energy industry and Cyber Security
- Experience with matrixed organizations and building strong stakeholder relationships
- Ability to navigate leadership and colleagues equally as well as sales and engineering teams
- Proven track record in developing and executing strategies that deliver results
- Ability to handle multiple assignments, passionate and highly persistent
- Solid technological aptitude with the ability to translate complex technical concepts to general audiences, in speaking and writing
- Snr. Leadership communication experience

Your benefits – because your contribution counts!

- Start & Perspective: Structured onboarding program and a permanent employment contract with long-term prospects 
- Development & Skills: Varied work in a forward-looking industry and individual opportunities for professional growth
- Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Overtime account, option to work from home up to 8 days per month, 30 days of vacation plus Christmas Eve and New Year’s Eve off, and the option for a sabbatical 
- Add-Ons: Business bike, gym allowance, company pension plan, Germany-wide train ticket (Deutschlandticket) 
- Team & Culture: Scandinavian-inspired with flat hierarchies, informal culture, and great team spirit
- You will join a small and evolving organization, where you are empowered to lead, define, motivate and shape how Vestas and its customers are made fit for future.

Global Offshore Sales is responsible for all sales related activities from early engagement, to bidding and negotiation until hand-over to Construction upon the completed closure of a contract. The wider team consists of a diverse group of motivated employees covering the globe, alongside a team that provides bid management and sales support.

Responsibilties:

- Face the customers throughout the entire sales process
- Be the head of negotiations including all aspects related to the commercial contract with support from relevant subject matter experts
- Direct the commercial parts and be the overall responsible for the bidding and contracting strategy to ensure an attractive but risk balanced offer
- Relationship building with customers and other stakeholders internally/externally
- Be accountable for the customer dialogue throughout the complete sales process and own the relationship of important accounts together with other stakeholders in Vestas

Qualifications:

- Significant interest and enthusiasm to work within renewables and specifically offshore wind
- Bachelor's degree in business administration (or similar), coupled with relevant professional and project management experience, ideally within the wind energy, power plants, infrastructure or the construction industry
- Understanding of the commercial and technical aspects of complex products and ability to translate this knowledge into a contractual context
- Experience with long-term sales processes and will be required to deliver results in a matrix organisation selling large-scale projects
- Experience with Yellow FIDIC Book
- Fluent English required, Polish language skills would be a significant asset

Competencies:

- Demonstrate significant ability to effectively deliver results on high stake projects under complex and varying conditions
- Advanced communication skills and ability to build support from internal stakeholders and work effectively in a matrix organization
- Capable to take discussions and influence Executive Management
- Comfortable to take discussions with C-Level Contacts with the largest customers

Your benefits – because your contribution counts:

- Start & Perspective: Structured onboarding program and a permanent employment contract with long-term prospects 
- Development & Skills: Varied work in a forward-looking industry and individual opportunities for professional growth
- Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Overtime account, option to work from home up to 8 days per month, 30 days of vacation plus Christmas Eve and New Year’s Eve off, and the option for a sabbatical 
- Add-Ons: Business bike, gym allowance, company pension plan, Germany-wide train ticket (Deutschlandticket) 
- Team & Culture: Scandinavian-inspired with flat hierarchies, informal culture, and great team spirit

What you will do

Projects:

- Facilitate assigned projects in terms of the given time and cost targets
- Creation of time schedules and cost estimations for budgeting the projects
- Provide support to  end-to-end project execution based on the department’s project management process
- Apply all designated projects processes, starting with project order until handover to the client
- Responsibility for the safety of the construction sites related to the projects on behalf of Nexperia. Project manager will become construction manager
- Close cooperation with the Facility Management operations team to align with the needs and demands of the existing supply systems. Preparation of technical data to be put into the internal tracking software  
- Take account of production requirements while having construction sites

Specialty Gas Installation Systems:

- Responsible for the standardization of specialty gas installations systems
- Update and Revision of the Nexperia Guideline for the Semiconductor-Compliant Installation of High-Purity Gases
- Ensuring the latest state-of-the-art technology is applied under consideration of required quality, safety, 24/7 production requirements and economic reasons
- Maintain and review the test protocol and welding procedures for contractors to ensure appropriate installation
- Owner of the guideline, training to the FM team and continuous exchange with contractors and suppliers

General:

- Main key stakeholders will be the Global FM Manager and Manager Projects within the Real Estate/Facility Management group, as well as the Site Manager and the Production manager of the site Hamburg
- Support of quality, safety, environmental and energy management systems according to the requirements of the standards IATF:16949, OHSAS:18001, ISO:14001 and ISO:5000

What you will need

- Masters degree in process engineering or similar
- Minimum of 3 years of experience, working in a similar role
- Working experience in a comparable field is desirable
- Project management skills by using typical software such as MS Project
- Proficient knowledge of MS Office applications (Excel, Word, Power Point), knowledge of CAD software is desirable
- Quick comprehension of technically complex tasks
- Experience in semiconductor industries or comparable is a plus
- Strong communication skills due to varying requesters and the ability to listen precisely to the required needs
- Structured way of working is required
- Persistence, assertiveness, and determination are mandatory habits to meet the job requirements
- Fluent German and English

The Senior/Principal Application Engineer will drive the development of reference designs and

application boards with a strong focus on Industrial motor-control and motor-drive applications

that showcase Nexperia’s portfolio. This position is part of our System and Application Team and

plays a critical role in bridging product development and customer requirements by translating

device capabilities into practical, production ready hardware solutions

The role is central to enabling customer adoption and accelerating time-to-market through high

quality design collaterals, hands-on validation and technical support

IHRE HAUPTAUFGABEN

• Design, develop, and validate reference designs and application boards using Nexperia’s

discrete, analog, and power IC solutions

• Create schematics, perform component selection, and collaborate on PCB layout to optimize

performance, efficiency, cost, thermal behavior, and reliability

• Perform comprehensive electrical, thermal, and system-level validation, including efficiency

analysis, switching characterization, transient response testing, thermal profiling, and

EMI/EMC pre-compliance evaluation and troubleshooting

• Provide application-focused technical support to customers and sales teams by

troubleshooting designs, supporting design-in activities, participating in customer

engagements, and representing Nexperia at workshops, conferences, and exhibitions

• Create and maintain high-quality technical collateral such as application notes, design guides,

simulation models, user manuals, and web-based application content

• Build deep application expertise and translate customer insights into future product

opportunities by collaborating with marketing, R&D, and system architects to define

requirements, identify use cases, and contribute to product roadmap development

IHR PROFIL

• Education/ studies: BSEE. MSEE preferred

• Min 5 years of experience in application engineering, hardware design or power electronics

• Proven experience developing reference designs or evaluation boards for various types of

machine drives: stepper motors, brushed DC motors, BLDCs, PMSMs and induction drives

• Experience in Robotics and Automation Systems is a strong advantage

• Strong understanding of three-phase power systems, inverter topologies,

• Switching behaviour, losses and efficiency optimization

• Technical experience in PCB design and layout – Altium, KiCad

• Familiarity with simulation tools and industry standards - Matlab/Simulink, LT Spice, Plecs,

Thermal analysis, EMC compatibility

• Strong analytical and system-level thinking

• Hands-on, problem-solving mindset with attention to detail

• Ability to work in cross-functional and global teams

• Customer focused approach with strong ownership

• Excellent presentation and technical writing skills

• English business fluent verbal and written, German nice to have.

As a (Senior) Process Development Engineer (m/f/d), you will play a key role in advancing competitive silicon-based discrete power technologies, driving innovation from process development to industrial manufacturing.

Working in a cross-functional environment with product, production and quality engineering teams, you will develop and industrialize robust wafer fabrication processes that enable cost-efficient, scalable and high-performance semiconductor products.

You will act as a process architect within development projects, translating product requirements into manufacturable process concepts and ensuring successful transfer into stable, automotive-qualified production.

This is your new job

- Define and integrate robust, scalable wafer fabrication flows by combining and optimizing unit processes
- Own and drive end-to-end process development from concept to stable high-volume manufacturing within cross-functional projects
- Ensure manufacturability and industrial readiness, including alignment with production, quality and automotive qualification requirements
- Optimize and balance process performance (yield, cost, quality, robustness) to meet competitive product and manufacturing targets
- Act as key technical interface between development and production, driving cross-functional alignment and sustainable solutions
- Benchmark competitor technologies and derive actionable insights for technology development
- Build and leverage expert networks to support technology development and continuously deepen process know-how

This is you

- Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, Semiconductor Physics or a related field
- Several years of relevant experience in semiconductor process development are preferred
- Solid understanding of semiconductor devices and industrial wafer fabrication processes, preferably for discrete power devices
- Hands-on experience in wafer processing and related equipment
- Strong analytical skills and ability to solve complex technical problems in a structured and result-oriented way
- Ability to work effectively in cross-functional and international teams
- Strong sense of ownership and accountability for technical outcomes
- Good organizational and planning skills with a structured working style
- Fluent in English and German, both written and spoken

About the role

As a Procurement Specialist within Nexperia’s Global Procurement organisation, you will lead the Equipment Parts & Services (EPS) category for our Hamburg and Manchester manufacturing sites. This is a high‑impact role managing a diverse, global supplier base, ranging from daily‑touch strategic partners to niche suppliers engaged once every few years.

You will directly own and manage relationships around 100 key suppliers at an average annual spend of around $40m. You will also act as a primary commercial interface for up to 500 suppliers across all equipment parts and services for both manufacturing sites. The work is varied, fast‑paced, and strategically significant no two weeks look the same.

This role offers a great chance to develop your Procurement skillset within a fast paced, high tech global company with occasional international travel for collaboration purposes.

Key Responsibilities include

- Sourcing Strategy Leadership  - Drive and lead sourcing strategies that deliver competitive cost structures and long‑term value for EPS categories
- Stakeholder Collaboration -  Shape requirements with engineering, operations, and site teams, providing commercial insight and value‑creation opportunities
- Market & Spend Analysis -  Conduct market research, analyse spend categories, and apply insights to negotiation and sourcing strategies
- Global Negotiation Leadership - Lead complex commercial negotiations with cross‑functional, international teams; develop negotiation plans for high‑value global projects
- Supplier Performance Management - Manage supplier performance across quality, cost, delivery, technology, and service to maintain a best‑in‑class supply base
- Contract Ownership - Draft, negotiate, and manage supplier contracts to secure optimal terms and mitigate commercial risk
- Project Delivery -  Lead global sourcing projects, including scope creation, negotiation planning, and delivery of measurable results
- Operational Excellence-  Drive adoption of procurement tools, processes, and continuous improvement initiatives across EPS activities

This is you

Essential requirements:

- Bachelor’s degree level education or equivalent experience
- 3+ years of procurement experience in a manufacturing or engineering environment
- Experience of participation or leading cross site commodity and international procurement projects
- Strong Negotiation and Analytical Skills
- Excellent English verbal and written communication skills
- Team player and a hands-on worker
- Ability to prioritize and work on multiple activities at one time
- Ability to work independently and with autonomy
- SAP, Ariba, MS Excel, PowerPoint presentation and data analytical skills
- Strong teamwork and collaboration skills on an international level

he Nexperia European Purchasing team is seeking a driven and dedicated Procurement Specialist with a focus on Direct materials (Specialist chemicals and gases) used during the manufacturing process for sites based in the UK and Germany. This position will provide you with the opportunity to work with varying stakeholders in the Production, Engineering, Environmental and Quality teams across both sites whilst building effective relationships with global suppliers.

What you will do:

As a Procurement Specialist for Direct manufacturing materials, you will work on a Hybrid basis at one of our front-end manufacturing sites in either Manchester UK or Hamburg Germany. This position plays a critical role in ensuring that procurement processes, controls and supplier management activities operate effectively and efficiently. You will support both local and global sourcing initiatives, driving cost optimisation, supplier performance and overall strategic procurement execution. Being part of a global company, you will also get the chance to support Global Sourcing Managers in the implementation of commodity sourcing strategies on site, enhancing your development pathways at Nexperia.

Key Responsibilities Include:

Sourcing & Supplier Management

- Identify, assess, and onboard suppliers to support operational and development needs.
- Support Global Sourcing Managers with the negotiation and procurement of BOM materials, including metal commodities, and ensure effective implementation of POs, consignment, and contracts.
- Manage supplier performance across quality, cost, delivery, technology, and service to maintain a high‑performing, competitive supply base.
- Ensure continuous supply is maintained into the Sites

Strategic Procurement & Market Insight

- Contribute to the execution of commodity sourcing strategies at site level, ensuring alignment with global procurement objectives.
- Conduct market research and analyse spend categories to inform negotiation strategies and drive value creation.
- Provide commercial insights to stakeholders, ensuring requirements are met while maintaining a competitive sourcing environment.

Cross‑Functional Collaboration & Project Delivery

- Partner with Supply Chain, Engineering, and Production teams to deliver annual cost‑reduction and sourcing project targets.
- Support project management activities, including supplier onboarding, qualification sample coordination, and new development communication.
- Ensure effective alignment between suppliers and internal teams to support operational and development programmes.

Process Ownership & Continuous Improvement

- Support the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of efficient end‑to‑end procurement processes and strong internal controls.
- Benchmark procurement practices against industry leaders and drive strategic initiatives to achieve operational excellence.

What you will need 

**Essential requirements:** 

- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Procurement, Supply Chain, or a related field
- Minimum 3 years’ procurement experience in a manufacturing or engineering environment with direct materials
- Strong negotiation, stakeholder management, and relationship‑building skills
- Confident analysing and presenting numerical data, with strong problem‑solving ability
- Effective communicator with excellent English skills and the ability to collaborate across countries and time zones
- Skilled in SAP, Excel, PowerPoint, and data analysis tools
- Able to prioritise, adapt quickly, and work with urgency in a fast‑paced environment
- Experience in process improvement, change management, and driving cross‑functional collaboration.

Desirable experience:

- Exposure to the Semiconductor Industry
- Experience working with chemicals, gases or technical procurement

About the job

To strengthen our R&D organization, we are looking for an Automation & AI Specialist (m/f/d) who translates business requirements into scalable automation and AI supported solutions and actively contributes to improving the efficiency of our R&D processes. You will be directly involved in shaping the digitalization, automation, and AI enablement of R&D processes in an international, technology driven environment.

What you will do

- Translate R&D business and user requirements into effective system, process, and automation solutions
- Design, implement, test, and continuously improve automated workflows, AI-augmented data flows and AI Agents
- Ensure stable data flows, high data quality, and reliable system operations
- Operate and further develop R&D collaboration and workflow tools (e.g. SharePoint, monday.com, SwiftKanban), including hands on application support
- Actively support change adoption through structured onboarding, release communication and user enablement
- Work closely with Nexperia IT, internal stakeholders, and external partners

What you will need

- University degree in business administration, computer science, engineering, or a comparable technical discipline
- Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in a comparable position, depending on educational credentials
- Strong understanding of business process and R&D process automation
- Practical experience with scripting languages (e.g. Python, VBA); deeper software development skills are a plus
- Knowledge of data integration and data exchange, e.g. between SAP applications and other systems
- Hands on experience with collaboration and workflow tools such as SharePoint, monday.com, or comparable platforms
- Strong communication and networking skills and proficiency in German and English (written and spoken)
- Structured, solution oriented working style with a strong focus on quality
- Service oriented, reliable team player with a high level of flexibility combined with accountability and commitment.

About Nexperia

At Nexperia, legal expertise is a key enabler of our global business strategy. As a leading international semiconductor company, we operate in a complex, fast-moving environment where high quality legal advice truly matters. We are looking for an experienced Senior Legal Counsel who combines strong corporate and M&A expertise with business acumen and a collaborative mindset.

About the role

In this senior role you:

- Provide corporate legal support and ensure corporate compliance for the global Nexperia group, including Nexperia Germany and the Hamburg site (which includes corporate housekeeping and ESG).
- Act as secretary to the Nexperia Germany Board of Directors.
- Support the Deputy Chief Legal Officer ("DCLO") on specific matters in strategic corporate projects, such as in the field of Corporate/M&A, Finance, Tax and Treasury (which includes M&A, investments, strategic co-operations (incl R&D), intercompany agreements, treasury and insurance matters).
- Deliver commercial legal support to certain key customers under the supervision of the DCLO.
- Are managing disputes, litigation and claims (such as distributors, local suppliers etc).
- Are managing outside legal counsel and legal spend.
- Support the German Corporate Affairs department.

The role is based at our office in Hamburg, and you will report directly to the Deputy Chief Legal Officer.

What you will need

The ideal candidate has 6-10 years of relevant experience as a corporate lawyer or (in-house) legal counsel and is ready to further apply and deepen their expertise in an international environment.

Furthermore, you have:

- A completed university degree in law.
- A truly international mindset and have excellent communication skills in English (written and verbal).
- Strong knowledge of and experience in corporate law and ESG in an international setting.
- Relevant experience gained at a leading law firm and/or a multinational company (considered as an advantage).
- M&A experience (considered a strong advantage).
- Experience working closely with Finance, Treasury and/or Tax departments.
- Litigation experience (considered an advantage).
- Proven experience working with C‑suite and senior management stakeholders.

About the role

As a Project Manager for complex R&D and engineering programs, you will take end to end ownership of high impact, multi-site projects that shape our future product portfolio. You will operate at the intersection of advanced technology, global collaboration, and business success, driving projects from concept to execution while balancing quality, timing, cost, and risk.

This is your new job

Lead and Deliver Complex Projects

- Take full accountability for the execution of complex multi-site R&D and engineering projects
- Define and drive the overall project plan in alignment with key stakeholders and management up to executive level
- Ensure project delivery within agreed specification, quality, cost, timeline, and reporting boundaries
- Define and ensure compliance with relevant quality standards throughout the project lifecycle

Build and Lead High Performance Teams

- Define required competencies, roles, and resources and build a strong, results oriented project team
- Provide clear leadership, operational guidance, and constructive conflict management
- Enable effective collaboration across functions, sites, and cultural boundaries, with strong engagement of global teams

Master Risk, Change, and Decision Making

- Identify, assess, and proactively manage project risks, dependencies, and scenarios
- Establish and lead the change management process for scope, cost, and timeline changes
- Apply sound judgment on project setup, execution strategies, timelines, budgets, methods, and technologies

Strengthen the Organization

- Coach and support other Project Leaders through peer exchange and reviews
- Contribute to the project management knowledge base by sharing lessons learned, best practices, and proven methodologies
- Actively drive continuous improvement in project execution to meet business targets and reduce time to market

What you will need

- University degree in a technical field or other relevant discipline
- Minimum 5 years of project management experience in semiconductors or related technical environment
- Strong hands-on experience with modern project management tools and methods
- Solid capability in planning, scheduling, budgeting, scope, risk, change, and stakeholder management
- Experience managing cross domain teams and external partners
- Semiconductor process and package knowledge is a strong advantage
- PMI or comparable project management certification is beneficial
- Proven leadership in building and guiding project teams in a global, intercultural environment
- Strong sense of ownership and accountability – you deliver on commitments and remove obstacles
- Clear customer and business orientation, with a constant focus on reducing time to market
- Excellent communication and negotiation skills in English, confident working with senior and executive stakeholders

About the job

As Volume Product Manager you will be part of our Diodes & Transistors Product Management Team. Together with four ambitious and motivated Product Managers in our team, you will take the full responsibility of our Diodes & Transistors strategy.

What you will do

- Act as the go-to-person for all industrial projects and strategic questions in terms of cost downs, outsourcing and 2nd source activities
- Define an industrial strategy, start and support initiatives, guide Business Group internal as well as front-end and back-end teams
- Responsible for PCN implementation, roadmap updates and cost benchmarking
- Work closely together with Operations, Volume Product Management Protection & Filtering as well as Commercial Marketing
- Cooperate with our wafer fabs, assembly sites as well as subcontractors around the globe
- Support long term planning, deep dive and other business reviews and strategic activities
- Align closely on operational processes for Diodes & Transistors with Demand Management and Supply Chain

What you will need

- University degree in a technical discipline
- Minimum 5 years of relevant working experience in Product Management, Operations or Development function within the semiconductor industry
- Direct or indirect leadership experience in leading international / cross-cultural teams
- Excellent communication skills and proven track record in managing cross-functional projects 
- Preferably knowledge of semiconductor markets, customers and/or supply chains
- Excellent decision-making skills
- Excellent analytical skills and structured work approach
- Highly self-motivated, team-oriented, result-driven
- Strong customer mindset and interest in global supply chains
- Excellent Microsoft Office skills, including Excel & PowerPoint
- Fluent in English mandatory, German language is a plus

jobs.occupation: Principal Product Application Engineer (m/f/d) – Diodes & Transistors (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
jobs.description:
About the job

As Principal Product Application Engineer, you will be responsible for the Application Strategy and Application Knowledge management for our Diodes & Transistors portfolio. In addition to technical support for our leading customers from the automotive, industrial and consumer industries, you are our main interface to our Product Management and R&D teams in order to build up a future proof product portfolio.

What you will do

- Qualify the value of Nexperia's products (strengths versus competitive products) and quantify the technical benefits derived from choosing Nexperia
- Take the lead for product requirements based on application insights
- Represent Nexperia’s application perspective in technical comities and Standardization groups as well as establishing and maintaining technical contacts to key decisions makers and influencers like Car OEMs and reference design houses and of course Industry Lead Customers
- Translate application expertise and customer insights into “customer requirement specifications” and build a future proof product portfolio
- Conduct product investigations and circuit analysis on application level
- Set up demo boards and represent the Nexperia Diodes & Transistors group at trade fairs

What you will need

- University degree in electrical engineering or other related technical discipline
- Minimum 5 years of relevant work experience in the semiconductor industry or in a related business
- Ideally proven experience within the Automotive/Industrial/Consumer Electronics environment
- Development and Engineering experience, as well as hardware design know how
- Simulation and measurement know-how are a plus
- Entrepreneurial thinking, result oriented, customer focused
- Strong communication and negotiation skills in English. German language is a plus
- Team player with hands-on mentality and proven track record in working in multicultural/international teams

jobs.occupation: Principal Product Quality Engineer (m/f/d) – Silicon Carbide (SiC) (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
jobs.description:
Job Description

About the role

As Principal Product Quality Engineer SiC, you will drive and design the quality management strategies, including the qualification approach and execution, for next-generation SiC products for industrial and automotive applications, collaborating with cross-functional teams across the entire product development lifecycle (development, manufacturing, quality, test, and applications).

What you will do

- Represent the Quality Management within the development team
- Correlate the SiC failure mechanisms with reliability measures to be implemented into the product quality
- Responsible to define the qualification approach of product developments for SiC products
- Responsible for implementation of quality procedures & quality standards (Nexperia, JEDEC, AEC and customer specific) in the projects
- Responsible for final test specifications and verifications
- Promote quality as value added to internal and external stakeholders
- Support customer requests and complaint handling
- Responsible to identify and address quality gaps in product creation process
- Define qualification requirements & support qualification of manufacturing processes
- Documentation and handling of data in analysis tools and evaluation wrt. Reliability, Yield, FMEA, Customer requests, etc.
- Activities to identify root causes for yield loss or other production problems as well as the implementation of containment and corrective actions
- Responsible for creation of the initial input for PCNs, review and issue, and support follow up activities

What you will need

- PhD or master’s degree in Electronics Engineering, Physics or a similar discipline
- Minimum 5 years’ experience in a similar position, experienced in wafer fab and assembly processes preferred, depending on educational credentials
- Knowledge in semiconductor physics as well as in semiconductor applications, preferably in the SiC domain
- Knowledge of international quality standards and policies e.g. AEC-Q101, AQG 324
- Familiar with measurement methods and equipment as well as device testing environments
- Familiar with standard software tools (e.g. Office), problem solving techniques
- High quality mindset and ability to work under pressure
- Fluent spoken and written English skills
- Strong know how in statistical data analysis
- Good communication and presentation skills
- Good team player and willingness to travel
- Assertiveness and demonstrated influencing skills
- Ability to create a trusted network within the organization
- Experience in resolving conflicts and disagreements among others
- Open mindset, which welcomes changes and views problems as opportunities

jobs.occupation: Head of Sourcing (m/f/d) - Front End BOM (Leiter/in - Einkauf)
jobs.description:
About the role

This critical role oversees the global FE BoM category; all direct materials we purchase to enable our frontend manufacturing. The subcategories within FE BoM include Silicon raw wafers, Process chemicals, specialty gases, sputtering targets incl. precious metals, and photomasks, all of which we buy from a qualified global supply base.

You will lead a high performing team of successful sourcing managers located in both Hamburg and Manchester, each of which hold several years of experience within Nexperia. In a highly dynamic environment, you - together with your team - will work cross-functionally ensuring supply resilience with our global suppliers as well as key stakeholders across sites.

This is your new job:

- Own end-to-end sourcing responsibility for all critical front-end materials categories used for Front End production and test, incl. achieving agreed objectives and key results (OKRs)
- Define, execute and adapt global category strategies aligned with our corporate strategy, technology roadmaps, and market dynamics
- Drive cost reduction and value creation initiatives, leveraging should-cost models, negotiations, and innovation
- Lead commercial negotiations and close (long-term) supply contracts, apply pricing models
- Ensure stable supply, proactively managing capacity, allocation, inventory and various supply chain risks implementing multi-sourcing and business continuity strategies
- Develop and manage strategic and long-term supplier relationships, including regular review meetings involving executive levels and occasional supplier visits, as well as frequent supplier performance management
- Lead supplier development initiatives to improve quality, cost competitiveness, and yield
- Collaborate cross-functionally with our Business Group R&D teams, engineering, operations, controlling and quality teams to enable product development and support manufacturing excellence
- Lead sourcing activities for NPI materials, including SiC and GaN wafers, ensuring supplier readiness and timely industrialization (Time to Market)
- attend industry conferences and prepare market intelligence and strategic insights into supply trends, cost, and technology developments for internal stakeholders
- Support procurement transformation and sustainability requirements and drive improvement initiatives

This is you:

- University degree in business management or technical discipline
- Minimum 10 years of sourcing experience in manufacturing industry with at least 5 years in a senior management position
- Proven track record of strong leadership responsibility in an international environment
- Strong teamwork and collaboration skills on an international level
- Excellent English speaking and communication skills amongst various groups of stakeholders, also across borders (Tier 1+2 sites). Any other language like Mandarin, Japanese or German is a plus
- Proven negotiation and analytical skills, and a good understanding of current ESG requirements 
- Out of the box thinker while continuously challenging the status quo
- Willingness to travel occasionally

About the role

In this exciting role, you will be responsible for the development of Silicon Carbide (SiC) products.

This is your new job

- Responsible for functionality & performance of the final product
- Work together with simulations, layout and manufacturing teams
- Develop and implement new technology concepts to manufacturing
- Ensure the process integration of the full manufacturing route
- Support the definition of test structures for technology characterization
- Co-operate with internal and external development and production partners

This is you

- PhD or Master ‘s Degree in Semiconductor Device Physics or Technology, Microelectronics or equivalent
- Minimum 3 years of demonstrated working experience in power semiconductor technology, preferably SiC in industrial environment, depending on educational credentials
- Team player with a strong drive to achieve success
- Fluency in English, conversational German is desirable
- Good communication skills, both verbal and in writing

jobs.occupation: Sr. Principal GaN/SiC Reliability Engineer (m/f/d) (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
jobs.description:
About the role
As Senior Principal Reliability Engineer GaN/SiC (m/f/d), you will play a crucial role in ensuring the reliability and durability of our GaN and SiC products, by supporting customers with reliability and lifetime predictions, with product reliability competence, developing reliability testing, analyzing failure mechanisms, optimizing designs and processes, and providing valuable insights to enhance the overall performance and reliability of our technologies.

This is your new job

- Develop and manage the reliability test plan for GaN/SiC products and calculate extrapolated lifetime for given mission profiles
- Enable early identification and characterization of failure mechanisms and link to performance and lifetime limitations through simulation and predictive analytics
- Determining the effect of the different stress factors on the lifetime and plot the failure distribution for each stressor as result of test-to-fail
- Derive lifetime models and drifts prediction for main parameters. Identify fail-in-time estimation (FIT, ppm)
- Setup a lifetime estimation model fitting customers application profile, derive pass/fail criteria
- Enable early identification and characterization of failure mechanisms and link to performance and lifetime limitations through simulation and predictive analytics
- Manage the concept of reliability tests with external partners
- Drive reliability tests and analyze reliability test results data to extract acceleration parameters
- Collaborate closely with design, quality, product engineering, packaging, and process technology teams to drive Design for Reliability (DfR) into product development
- Identify and address reliability gaps and drive reliability improvements activities
- Collaborate with the R&D and Quality teams to develop/improve tests and analysis methods of GaN and SiC products
- Monitor failure analysis investigation to understand the main wear-out failure mechanisms
- Establish and lead external partnerships with universities, research consortia, and industry working groups on Power Semiconductor reliability standards and methods for wide band gap materials

This is you:

- Master's Degree or equivalent in Experimental Physics, Electronics Engineering, or a similar discipline, PhD preferred
- Strong knowledge of GaN and SiC semiconductor physics, or at least of one of the two technologies and the ability to learn the other
- Minimum 7 years of experience of power semiconductor devices, ideally wide band gap and GaN HEMTs
- Understanding of mechanical, electrical and thermal failure modes in semiconductor products, and failure analysis techniques
- Knowledge of international quality standards such as JEDEC, AEC-Q101, AQG 324, reliability test to fail methods, and reliability test equipment
- Experience working within GaN and/or SiC reliability in an industrial environment is highly advantageous,
- Strong knowledge of wafer fab processes. Knowledge of assembly process preferred
- Strong data analysis skills (JMP, MATLAB, etc.) with clear written and verbal communication skills
- High quality mindset, towards product and customers
- Fluent spoken and written English skills
- Strong know how in statistical data analysis
- Excellent communication and presentation skills
- Ability to work under pressure
- Good team player and willingness to travel
- Assertiveness and demonstrated influencing skills
- Ability to create a trusted network within the organization
- Experience in resolving conflicts and disagreements among others
- Open mindset, which welcomes changes and views problems as opportunities
